project_info.theme: Toyota Hilux breakthrough presence at Vietbuild 2026
project_info.color_palette: White, black, industrial red, orange, metallic gray

main_subject.detail: An event-recap poster shot at an exhibition booth, featuring a white Toyota Hilux pickup in a front low-angle view indoors. Large text at the bottom reads 'HILUX BUT PHA CHINH PHUC VIETBUILD 2026' and below it 'Cam on cac Quy khach hang da den trai nghiem'. The booth behind the truck has large Toyota branding, a 'HILUX' sign, red industrial accents, city-skyline silhouette decor, stop sign, cones, and display boards. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Photoreal expo-floor automotive poster with industrial booth design, event-documentary realism, and bold recap typography

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / HILUX / Move your world / HILUX BUT PHA / CHINH PHUC VIETBUILD 2026 / Cam on cac Quy khach hang da den trai nghiem
items: Top Left: Toyota logo and skyline silhouette integrated into the exhibition booth
Top Right: 'HILUX' sign, stop sign, and lit industrial display structure
Bottom Left: Booth counter area and event flooring leading toward the truck
Bottom Right: Handwritten 'Move your world' and thank-you event message
Center/Background: White Toyota Hilux pickup displayed on an indoor event stage with red-and-black industrial booth styling

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Trade-show spotlights, reflective polished bodywork, documentary booth ambience

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal event photography with recap-poster typography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Hilux event recap at Vietbuild 2026. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Hilux pickup photographed from a low front angle inside a large industrial-themed exhibition booth. Background is a Toyota-branded expo setup with red accents, signage, cones, skyline decor, and display boards. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'HILUX BUT PHA CHINH PHUC VIETBUILD 2026', the thank-you line 'Cam on cac Quy khach hang da den trai nghiem', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal event photography with recap-poster typography, indoor expo-event lighting, spotlights and reflective bodywork, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
